title: Order Cancel Rejected - Too Late to Cancel
causes: Order already matched and executed on central limit order book
actions: Treat order as filled; reconcile client position

title: Order Cancel Rejected - Unknown Order ID
causes: OrigClOrdID not present in active matching book; order previously cancelled or expired

title: Order Execution Rejected by Exchange Risk Engine
causes: Pre-trade risk limit exceeded; price collar violation
actions: Check buying power allocation and tick bounds
